title.narrative: SPX Nigeria - Assistance in Establishing an Industrial Subcontracting and Partnership Exchange in Nigeria

description.narrative: The proposal for the establishment of an SPX in Nigeria was made in a letter from Mrs. Adelaja, Director-General, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Agency of Nigeria (SMEDAN) to UNIDO Director General dated 21 September 2006 (Annex 1). This project is mostly funded by SMEDAN (USD 176,000) and the Government of Nigeria (USD 24,000). The remainder (USD 80,000) will be covered by a Regional Programme being developed for the Africa SPX Network. This project will assist in the establishment of an Industrial Subcontracting and Partnership Exchange (SPX) in Nigeria, hosted by the Enterprise Development Service (EDS) Centre within Lagos Business School (LBS), to promote subcontracting and partnership agreements between Nigerian subcontractors and suppliers and national or foreign main-contractors and buyers. It will focus on key SPX sectors such as metal and plastic industries and seek cooperation with transnational companies in the oil and gas sector for the local content development of their purchases. This Project is part of the CSF for Nigeria (Annex 2) and will also be part of the #Regional Programme for Investment Promotion, Facilitation and Governance Enhancement in Africa# (Annex 3).
